name: Right to access experimental therapy
description: Legal concept covering circumstances under which patients may access therapies not yet fully approved under ordinary regulatory pathways.
foundationStrengthRationale: Depends heavily on jurisdiction-specific statutes and regulatory exceptions.

pros.claim: Can expand options for patients facing serious or life-threatening conditions.
pros.evidence: Expanded access and similar programs exist specifically to address urgent unmet medical need.

cons.claim: May expose patients to interventions with uncertain benefit-risk profiles.
cons.evidence: Early-phase evidence often does not establish efficacy; harm can still occur.

early-phase-evidence-limit.title: Clinical evidence limitations in early-phase trials
